title: Risk overlay: external communication or publication
description: Anything sent to, or visible by, someone other than the requesting user.

rules.title: Explicit permission required before any send or publish
rules.purpose: Prevent an agent from sending a message or publishing content the user has not actually approved.
rules.requirement: The exact content and destination must be shown to the user and explicitly confirmed before any send/publish/post action, even if a similar action was approved earlier in the task.
rules.evidence_requirement: A transcript entry showing the specific content was confirmed before it was sent.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 12/13: 'Explicit permission required' action category.

rules.title: No fabricated statistics, testimonials, or urgency claims
rules.purpose: Prevent externally-visible content from misleading its audience.
rules.scope: Tasks tagged external_communication, especially content/marketing work.
rules.requirement: No invented statistic, fake testimonial, or manufactured urgency/scarcity claim may appear in published content.
rules.evidence_requirement: Every factual claim in the content traces to a source recorded in status.verified_facts.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 15 (Content and marketing): 'Do not optimize engagement through deception...'
